create_LatentWidget: create a LatentWidget instance with a viz object to control latent space navigation
drag_latent_coordinates: drag the latent widget by dx and dy offsets to adjust x and y coordinates
render_latent_UI: call the LatentWidget to render an ImGui UI with seed input, drag button, and anim controls
compute_w0_seeds: compute bilinear interpolation weights across four neighboring seeds from the current latent position
reset_latent_state: reset the latent widget state back to its default x, y, anim, and speed values
